Remark
[solution of the comparison ODE]

Source: petersen:page-0502 ↗ thm:pet-ch12-toponogov 1. ch12:12.8.3Show that the solution of $\ddot\xi =-(1+\varepsilon )\xi $, $\xi (0)=\psi (0)>0$, $\dot\xi (0)=\dot\psi (0)>0$ is \[ \xi (t)=\sqrt{\psi (0)^2+\frac{\dot\psi (0)^2}{1+\varepsilon }}\, \sin \Big(\sqrt{1+\varepsilon }\, t+\arctan \Big(\frac{\psi (0)\sqrt{1+\varepsilon }}{\dot\psi (0)}\Big)\Big). \]
